title: I Absolutely Adore your Cheerful Smile

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As they realized that Cotton candy-chan was a super-class monster named Hell Dog, {0} and the others headed towards its containment──
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたあめちゃんが、超特級クラスの妖魔・ヘルドッグだと分かり、
{0}たちは、その対処に向かう──

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrrr......Bow wow!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガルルルル……
バウバウッ！！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~~~!! 
What is that monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃあ～～～！！
何よ、
あの怪物！？

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: It's terrible! The city is already experiencing damage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大変だ！　
もう街に被害が出てるぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Cotton candy-chan, wait! Stay calm~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたあめちゃん、
待って！　
落ち着くさ～！

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text:
Be careful, don't recklessly get involved! 
You'll end up getting eaten alive!
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ないぞ、
うかつに手を出すな！
食い殺されちまうぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: No way...!
text_block_list.orig_text: そんな……！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, are you all okay? 
Are there any injuries?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなさん、
大丈夫デスか？
怪我は
ありまセンか？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text:
I'm not injured, but the festival preparations are ruined!
The stalls were destroyed and all the ingredients were eaten!
text_block_list.orig_text:
怪我はねえけど、
祭りの準備が台無しだ！
屋台が壊された上に、
材料が全部食われちまった！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yes, us too! 
Even though we came up with new menu ideas just for Halloween!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
うちもよ！
ハロウィンのために、
せっかく新メニューも考えたっていうのに！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
New menu...
Is everyone perhaps a sweet shop?
text_block_list.orig_text:
新メニューって……
みんな、
もしかしてスイーツのお店だったり？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text:
Ah... 
I was getting pumped up because the Halloween Festival is starting soon...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
もうすぐハロウィンフェスティバルが始まるから気合入れてたのに……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Earlier, I was surrounded by a small white dog in the store... This year has been a complete mess...
text_block_list.orig_text:
この前も、
小さな白い犬に店を囲まれるし……
今年はもう散々よ……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Even when you're angry,
it seems like you still have a sweet tooth~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
怒ってても、
相変わらず
甘い物好きみたいだね～……

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: Ah... This insatiable appetite reminds me of someone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
この食い意地の強さ、
誰かを思い出すよ……

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: Hmm... You guys are from the other day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むっ……
君たちは先日の！

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: There was a report of a giant dog causing a rampage... The appearance of the monster I had brought with me the other day is different, Could there be a connection?
text_block_list.orig_text:
巨大な犬が暴れていると報告があったが……
先日連れていた妖魔とやらとは姿形が違うが、
もしや関係があるのか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Um, well... There were a few things that happened and she ended up like this, so she ran away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えっと……
ちょっといろいろあって
ああなっちゃって、
それで逃げ出しちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text:
...I see. 
Do you remember telling me that you would take measures if any actual harm occurred?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そうか。
実害が出た場合は対処する、
と伝えたのは覚えているな？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
But no one got hurt~! 
Well, the food stalls got destroyed though...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
誰も怪我させてないさ～！
や、
屋台は壊されちゃったけど……

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text:
That is considered a real harm.
Even if it's not happening now, if we leave it unchecked,
there will be injured people soon...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを実害だというのだ。
今は出ていなくても、
野放しにしていたら怪我人もすぐに……

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text:
I must admit, this is not my intention... 
After all, it's so fluffy and cute... cough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私とて本意ではない……
なにせ、
ふわふわでかわいいからな……
こほん。

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text:
However! 
The top priority is our duty!
In other words, the safety of the citizens!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし！
優先すべきは職務！　
すなわち、
市民の安全である！

text_block_list.name: Knight Captain
text_block_list.text: Attention all squads! We must subdue it by any means necessary! It may be fast, but we will pursue it to the ends of the earth! Do not let it inflict any further damage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
全隊に通達！　
なんとしても討伐しろ！
逃げ足は速いが、
地の果てまで追うんだ！　
これ以上、
被害を出すな！

text_block_list.name: Knights of the Order
text_block_list.text: Understood!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 了解っ！！！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Th-That's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Kaorin... Shall we do what we can do on our own?
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオりん……
うちらはうちらで
できることをやろ？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: That's right! First, in order to minimize the damage, let's guide them to a place where there are no people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうデス！　
まずは、
被害を抑えるためにも、
人けのないところに誘導しまショウ。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: If we do that, the knight order might lend us their ears!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうすれば、
騎士団も聞く耳を持ってくれるかもしれまセン！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Well, even if we try to guide them, they won't listen to our words... Neither humans nor gods...
text_block_list.orig_text:
といっても、
誘導するにも
ワタシたちの言葉に耳をかしまセンから……
ニントモカントモデ～ス……

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: The opponent is a Hell dog... I don't care about the words of pathetic humans...
text_block_list.orig_text:
相手はヘルドッグだからな……
ちんけな人間の言葉なんて、
構いやしないさ……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
But for us, it's Cotton Candy-chan! 
A white, fluffy and super cute puppy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
うちらにとっては、
わたあめちゃんだよ！
白くて、
ふわっふわで
もにカワなわんちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: She always eat sweets, and because she looks like cotton candy, Kaorin gave her that nickname...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっつもスイーツばっか食べてて、
わたあめに似てるから、
って
カオりんがそんなあだ名つけて……

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: No, that is the true form...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや、
あれが正体さ……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right... 
That's right!
She's definitely Cotton Candy-chan, Cotton Candy-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
そだ……
そうだよ！　
やっぱわたあめちゃんは、
わたあめちゃんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.orig_text: どういうことだ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Because she only eats sweets. 
She hasn't hurt anyone in the town,
and she attacked the food stalls just to eat, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
スイーツばっか食べてるもん。
街の人に怪我させてないし、
屋台を襲ったのは
食べるためっしょ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: So, even if you're angry, the things we do are the same, right? In that case, if I give you sweets like before, you'll listen to what I say, won't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってことは、
怒っててもやることは一緒じゃん！
だったら、
前みたいにスイーツあげれば、
言うこと聞いてくれんじゃね？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: But it seems like she's eaten all the sweets from the food stalls~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
屋台のスイーツは
全部
食べ尽くしちゃったみたいさ～……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Jack's face, it's like a pumpkin, isn't it? 
How about putting cream on it like a pumpkin cake?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジャックさんの顔、
かぼちゃデスよね？
かぼちゃケーキみたいに、
クリーム塗ったりするのはどうデスか？

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text:
Cut the jokes! 
I am, after all, a prestigious elite spirit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
冗談はよせ！
オイラは、これでも
由緒正しきエリート精霊なんだぞ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Ninochi, that's a great idea!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二ノっち、
それナイスアイデア～！

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: Wait, a, second~...!

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: How about dressing up as a sweets cosplay and showing off? I saw a huge cake-shaped headpiece at a costume rental shop I saw the other day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
スイーツコスして、
アピるのはどお？
この前見かけた貸衣装屋に、
でっかいケーキの被り物があったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
And then, If I sprayed some sweet-smelling perfume, 
and voila! The moving sweets are complete~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんで、
あま～い匂いのする香水も振ってさ、
そしたら
動くスイーツの完成～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I don't think it's bad~!
Run and lead them outside of Landosol~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪くないと思うさ～！
走って、
ランドソルの外まで誘導するさ～！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.orig_text:
っしょ？　
あんなにおっきくなったんだし、
やっぱアピるなら
こっちもおっきいスイーツになんないと！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
If it's an uninhabited plain, there won't be any damage,
and the knights might even leave it to us~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
人けのない平原なら
被害も出ないし、
騎士団の人たちも、
私たちに
任せてくれるかもしれないさ～！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... However, the problem is who will do it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
フム……
ですが、
問題は
誰がやるかデスね……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're willing to take on dangerous missions yourself! 
As expected of the Shogun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オオー！　
自ら危険な任務を買って出るトハっ！
さすがショーグンデス！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Hidesai will be fine, Don't worry!
I believe in him to make a solid decision!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイなら大丈夫っしょ！
ビシッと決めれるって、
うち信じてるよ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
{0}, leave it to me! 
For the sake of Cotton Candy-chan, please take care of it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、
任せたよー！
わたあめちゃんのために、
よろしくねー！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's go prepare for the cosplay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ、
コスの準備
しにいこ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! There are various rental costumes lined up! 
What a lively shop!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オオー！　
いろいろな
貸衣装が並んでるデス！
なんとも賑やかな店デスね！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? Come to think of it, I can't seem to find Jack anywhere. 
We were together until we entered the shop, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや……？　
そういえば
ジャックさんの姿が見当たりまセンね？
お店に入るまでは
一緒だったはずデスが……

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: I'm here too, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text: ちゃんとオイラもいるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: I apologize for the rudeness! There are so many rental costumes with faces similar to Jack's, I can't tell them apart!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは失敬デース！　
ジャックさんと似たような顔の
貸衣装が多くて、
見分けがつきませんでシタ！

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: Could it be that you... Don't believe that I'm an elite spirit...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかしてお前……
オイラのこと、
エリート精霊だって信じてないだろ……？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two! This is no time to be playing around~ 
I'll help Suzuna~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら二人とも、
遊んでる場合じゃないさ〜
スズナの手伝いをするよ〜！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Ninochi, I have a cake hat, so bring some perfume! 
I'm doing makeup for Hidesai right now,
so I can't let go for a moment, so please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二ノっち〜、
ケーキの被り物はあったから、
香水持ってきて〜！
いまヒデサイにメイクしてるから、
ちょっと手離せないんでよろ〜！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Understood, Jack, please don't slack off and help me out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
了解デース！　
ジャックさんも
サボってないで、
手伝ってクダサイ！

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: You know, I can tell you don't believe me after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりお前、
信じてないな。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! It looks great, doesn't it? 
Hidesai, it suits you so well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん！　
いい感じじゃね？
ヒデサイ、
超似合ってる！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
What a peculiar appearance... 
There is not even a trace of the Shogun's dignity...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとも面妖な姿デスね……
ショーグンの威厳のかけらもありまセン……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: But, with this, it seems like Cotton Candy-chan will chase after me too~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
これならわたあめちゃんも
追いかけてくれそうだね〜！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
With this, the preparations are complete! 
Let's leave the store and lure out Cotton Candy-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで準備は整いまシタね！
店から出て、
わたあめちゃんをおびき出しまショウ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll blow the whistle...! 
Boooo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
では、
笛を鳴らしマスよ……！
ボオーオー！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! It's coming towards us with incredible force! 
And the footsteps are so loud!
The ground is shaking like crazy too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やばばばば！　
めっちゃすごい勢いでこっちきてるし！
足音デカすぎじゃね？　
地面も超揺れてるんですけどー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
{0}, I'll leave the rest to you! 
I'm sure you can do it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、あとは任せたさー！
キミならきっとできるさー！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: If it's the Shogun, this is a piece of cake! I believe in him too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショーグンなら、
これくらい朝飯前デス！　
ワタシも
信じていマス！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: You got it! After all, it's Hidesai super amazing, right? Hidesai, show us your super amazing side!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そだね！　
なんてったってヒデサイだもんね！
ヒデサイの超ヒデサイなとこ、
うちらに見せて！

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: ...Here I come!

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Bark bark!!
text_block_list.orig_text: バウバウッ！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hidesai, let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイ、
いっけー！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Shogun, please show us your incredible speed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショーグン、
韋駄天の走りをご披露してクダサイ！

text_block_list.name: カオリ
text_block_list.text:
やっさー！　
でーじがんばれ～！
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっさー！　
でーじがんばれ～！

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: Great! Keep running just like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいぞ！　
その調子で走れー！

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely, I have to send you back to the spirit world! 
{0}, I'm counting on you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対、霊界に送り返さなきゃいけないんだ！
{0}、
頼んだぞ！

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: If I were to fail, I would...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もし失敗したなんてことになったら、
オイラは──

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: バウッ？

text_block_list.name: Jack
text_block_list.text: Gyaa~!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ぎゃあ～～！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Did Jack get squashed~!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ジャックが踏み潰されたさ～！？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
While running, I'm talking to myself...
Speaking too much can be troublesome...
I guess I'm the type to dig my own grave.
text_block_list.orig_text:
走りながら自分語りしているからデス……
口は災いの元……
墓穴を掘るタイプデスね。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You seem like an elite spirit, so you'll be fine, right? 
Well, I'll catch up with you later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんかエリート精霊みたいだし、
大丈夫じゃね？
まあ、
あとで追いついてくるっしょ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That's not good, {0}'s pace has slowed down! 
I might be reaching my limit too... I might get caught up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより、
{0}のペースが落ちてきたさー！
もう限界かも……
追いつかれちゃうよー！

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Baaah!
text_block_list.orig_text: バウーッ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Shogun! Are you injured?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショーグン！　
お怪我は！？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: I fell in a flashy way, but it seems like my costume is the only thing that got damaged. As expected of Hidesai!
text_block_list.orig_text:
派手に転んだけど、
コスがダメになったくらいで済んだっぽいね。
さっすがヒデサイ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: And thanks to your hard running, we've gotten quite far away from the city~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
一生懸命走ってくれたおかげで、
街からだいぶ離れられたさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, the real deal starts now! 
I'll definitely stop Cotton Candy-chan, just you wait!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
ここからが本番だよー！
わたあめちゃんを、
絶対に止めてみせるさー！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
But, what should we do? 
I don't want to attack Cotton Candy-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
けどさ、
どーすんの？
うち、
わたあめちゃんを攻撃したくないし！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same too...! 
Even though you call them "spirit,"
